tools.name: adgpt_capabilities
tools.description: Search AdGPT operations or describe one in detail (input schema, auth, credit cost, async behavior). Use `operationId` to describe a specific operation, or `query` to search by name / domain / path.

tools.name: adgpt_account
tools.description: Read your profile, creative-credit balance, and in-flight generations; update your profile. No account yet? Start with register (or login) — the returned session token is adopted automatically and every later call runs as that user. Actions: register, login, me, credits, activeGenerations, updatePro

tools.name: adgpt_job
tools.description: Poll a long-running generation to completion. Pass the status `operationId` (from a create call's job handle) and its `params` (e.g. {id}). Waits up to `waitSeconds` (max 25); if not finished, returns callAgain=true — invoke again to keep waiting. Never charges credits.

tools.name: adgpt_upload_product_image
tools.description: Upload a product photo to AdGPT from the local machine — pass an absolute file_path (preferred) OR data_base64 (+ filename). Validates it is a usable product image (min 100×100px, aspect between 1:4 and 4:1), stores it, and returns {url, width, height}; pass that url in user_instructions.uploaded_im

tools.name: adgpt_campaigns
tools.description: Generate and manage Full Campaigns (FC) from a product URL, a manual product (name+description+images), or text-only. Each campaign generates (defaults): 6 image ads (3 with text + 3 clean), 4 video ads, 3 UGC presenter videos, 12 Google ad copy variations, 10 keywords, plus social captions. Tier (b

tools.name: adgpt_single_asset
tools.description: Generate a BATCH of premium creatives of one asset type (SAC), or bulk-order N assets in one request (bulk* actions: pricing, order, status, assets, cancel — credits charged upfront, failed items auto-refund) — image: 6 image ads (3 with text + 3 clean) · video: 4 video ads · ugc_video: 3 UGC presen

tools.name: adgpt_in_action
tools.description: Talking-head / UGC-in-action wizard for a SAC campaign: generate scripts, strategies, and per-character plans; preview voices; tag scripts; persist wizard state. Read adgpt://pipeline/characters and adgpt://pipeline/voices first. In-action and commercial videos need a Pro plan or higher. Actions: ge

tools.name: adgpt_ugc
tools.description: Browse the UGC presenter avatar and voice catalogs. (UGC videos themselves are generated through adgpt_campaigns, adgpt_single_asset and adgpt_in_action.) Actions: avatarsPaginated, voices. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.

tools.name: adgpt_edit_creative
tools.description: Post-generation editing of image and video assets: AI prompt edits, overlays (normalized geometry), video v2v + narration re-dub (voice/emotion/gender; language-dependent extras), version keep/discard/revert, caption edits, share links and social ad previews. In-action editing (inAction*) works on c

tools.name: adgpt_image_resize
tools.description: Smart Resize: subject-preserving platform-size renditions of your generated image ads — presets catalog, asset context, async batch (25 credits per size), batch status, and a campaign's existing renditions. Actions: smartPresets, smartResize, smartBatchStatus, smartAssetContext, smartCampaignRenditi

tools.name: adgpt_brands
tools.description: Manage brands: list, get, create, update, delete, and auto-fetch details from a URL (costs 5 credits). Actions: list, get, create, update, delete, fetchDetails. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.

tools.name: adgpt_catalog
tools.description: Product feeds and items: import a feed (xml|shopify), poll import status, and read and update products. Actions: list, get, createFeed, updateProduct, importStatus. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.

tools.name: adgpt_go_live
tools.description: Read-only status of your campaign's live ads: the current go-live, its history, and performance. Starting, renewing or stopping a go-live happens in the web app. Actions: current, history, performance. Call adgpt_capabilities with the operationId to see an action's parameters.

tools.name: adgpt_social
tools.description: Connect your own Facebook ad account, check connections, and publish to TikTok from an account you already connected in the web app: campaign/ad-group reads, targeting taxonomy, and create-ads. Actions: connectAccount, checkConnection, facebookExchangeToken, tiktokRegions, tiktokLanguages, tiktokCam

tools.name: adgpt_recreation
tools.description: Clone any existing ad: ingest it (URL or upload), analyze its hooks, script and scene structure, then generate your own version from one instruction (adGenerateFromPrompt). Poll adStatus; adCancel refunds an in-flight clone. Actions: adIngestUrl, adUpload, adAnalyze, adStatus, adGenerateFromPrompt,

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "adgpt_account" references sensitive artifacts (session token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: adgpt_brands, adgpt_catalog · Private data: adgpt_account · Public sink: adgpt_upload_product_image, adgpt_edit_creative, adgpt_social, adgpt_recreation · Destructive: adgpt_campaigns, adgpt_brands.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: adgpt_brands, adgpt_catalog · Private data: adgpt_account · Public sink: adgpt_upload_product_image, adgpt_edit_creative, adgpt_social, adgpt_recreation · Destructive: adgpt_campaigns, adgpt_brands

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
